name: Randomized treatment contrast
scope: Binary assignment; optional centered baseline covariates and their treatment interactions; HC3 or clustered CR1.

name: Linear instrumental-variable estimate
scope: 2SLS with robust or clustered covariance; requires identification beyond a first-stage association.

name: Augmented inverse-probability ATE
scope: Binary treatment ATE, cross-fitted propensity and outcome models.

name: Interactive-regression orthogonal score
scope: AIPW score with cross-fitted random forests for the binary-treatment ATE.

name: Partially linear orthogonal estimate
scope: Partially linear parameter; distinct from a general heterogeneous-treatment ATE.

name: Two-group two-period difference in differences
scope: Balanced panel differences or repeated-cross-section cell contrasts; treated-group indicator is constant within unit.

name: Local-randomization threshold comparison
scope: Sharp assignment inside an explicitly chosen window; distinct from local-polynomial RD.

name: Classical synthetic-control weights
scope: One treated unit, balanced panel, nonnegative donor weights summing to one; no invented confidence interval.

name: Sample summaries
scope: Positive optional weights; unweighted mean t intervals; weighted point estimates.

name: Distribution and inequality
scope: ECDF; Gini and Theil on nonnegative outcomes with positive mean.

name: Linear conditional association
scope: OLS or explicit WLS with HC3 or clustered CR1 covariance.

name: Tabular held-out prediction
scope: Regression or classification; explicit iid, group, spatial or forward-time split; preprocess training rows only.

name: Text classification or regression
scope: Training-only TF-IDF; declare empty-text handling and character or word features.

name: K-means exploratory groups
scope: Standardized features; repeated subsample agreement; groups require substantive interpretation.

name: Principal-component representation
scope: Standardized PCA; exports original columns plus PC1, PC2, etc.

name: Latent Dirichlet allocation topics
scope: Exploratory count-based topics; Chinese word analysis requires explicit tokenization.

name: Kaplan–Meier survival
scope: Independent right censoring, binary event, no left truncation; pointwise Greenwood normal approximation.

name: Rolling autoregressive prediction
scope: One regularly spaced series; expanding-window one-step OLS forecasts.

name: Global Moran spatial statistic
scope: Explicit weights matching data-unit order; fixed-weight random-label permutation test.

name: Observed simple network structure
scope: Undirected binary graph; duplicate edges collapsed; degree, clustering and connected components.

name: Two-group outcome-gap decomposition
scope: Reference group zero; within-group iid percentile bootstrap; descriptive decomposition.

name: Independent compatible-effect synthesis
scope: Common-effect or DerSimonian–Laird random effects, normal intervals; compatible scales required.

name: Holm and Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment
scope: Declared hypothesis family; BH uses independence or suitable positive dependence.

name: Split-conformal prediction intervals
scope: Exchangeable regression observations, separate train/calibration/test splits, marginal coverage target.
